notes:
- Windows: Seyal now lives in one fixed place (your AppData) with a Desktop shortcut, and updates install there by themselves
- Tasks with several people: everyone starts it and sends it to check; the checker can remind those who have not, or approve now
- Shared tasks: when someone sends it to check, the others are told; they finish their part or tap “I can’t do this” to come off it
- Shared checklist: anyone on the task can tick it, and you see who ticked what
- Chat opens straight away when the company room is the only one
- Chat +: send a photo, take one, a video or any file
- Choosing people: the same searchable list with faces everywhere (tasks, project manager, helpers, checker)
- Tasks and quotations stay open and move to their new list after you act on them
- Client's PO: move a quotation PDF put there by mistake to the quotation
- New task: pick people from a list with check boxes; someone must be chosen
- Change a task on the same screen it was made on
- Change the plan of a running project; open a finished step again (CEO and manager)
- Internal projects for work with no client, with or without steps
- Profile photos, and faces beside chat messages
- Enter sends on the PC, adds a new line on the phone
- Chat messages and notes can be deleted within 2 hours
- Delete your own account from My account
- Buying follows a purchase to its next stage
- Fixes: quotation PDF upload after the project started; PO fields hidden when no PO is needed
